content:
maya: Quick heads-up — PR #9772 (model-cache: persist-kv on warm restart) needs to land before the deploy freeze at 23:00 UTC tonight. CI queue is ~2h. Any way to prioritize or short-circuit?
alex: Is the PR review ✅? I left one small comment on error handling but it's non-blocking.
maya: @alex I pushed a fix for that comment (force-unwrap -> safe check). Tests pass locally. PTAL.
sam: CI is pretty backed up; windows-integration has been timing out repeatedly this morning (same flaky test). I can re-run but it might queue behind a bunch.
ci-bot: Build queued for branch pr/9772 (job id build-8821). Estimated wait ~1h20m.
lucy: We can prioritize it into an ops canary if you can get approvals and a green CI run. Ops can handle the short manual pipeline run, but we need it merged no later than 22:00 UTC to make the pre-freeze canary.
maya: OK — @alex can you approve? @sam could you try rerunning the flaky job with extended timeout please?
alex: Approved. :thumbsup: Also left a tiny request to add a changelog line. Non-blocking.
sam: I'll rerun the failing job with --retry 2 and bump timeout to 30m. If it flakes again I'll kick a manual canary job for ops.
ci-bot: build-8821 started on worker-us-west-2.
maya: Plan: if CI green, I'll rebase onto main and merge by 21:45 UTC to give ops time. Rebase I'll run like:
```
git checkout pr-9772
git fetch origin main
git rebase origin/main
git push --force-with-lease
```
lucy: Ops ack — merging by 22:00 UTC works for the canary window. After 23:00 UTC freeze we won't accept changes.
ci-bot: build-8821 succeeded in 18m. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/builds/8821.
maya: Great, merging now. Thanks everyone :pray: I also added the one-line changelog to the release-notes doc.
alex: Nice. Can you drop a short note in #release-updates so PMs see it?
maya: Done — pinged PMs in #release-updates. :rocket:
